proposed_experiments.title: Evidex → HOMS grounded critique
proposed_experiments.idea: Feed admitted source spans and uncertainty into HOMS review through the canonical Sophia adapter.
proposed_experiments.rationale: Custody checks can bind a critique to the sources without pretending that source validity proves academic merit.
proposed_experiments.value: Mutation test: alter or remove a source span; affected critiques must change or refuse, while unrelated critiques remain stable.

proposed_experiments.title: VAMP → Sophia competency evidence review
proposed_experiments.idea: Use admitted competency artifacts as source-bound review inputs, retaining metadata-only records as context only.
proposed_experiments.rationale: Reuse the canonical evidence boundary while preserving human assessment and original classification history.
proposed_experiments.value: Test whether suggestions cite the right artifact and abstain when evidence is insufficient; no inferred achievement credit.

proposed_experiments.title: ZPD revision shaping with outcome evidence
proposed_experiments.idea: Compare revision prompts with and without artifact-bound ZPD guidance using the same source/rubric inputs.
proposed_experiments.rationale: The installed binder makes input identity testable; learning or quality improvement still requires independent evidence.
proposed_experiments.value: Blind educator comparisons, revision usefulness and controlled error rates; preserve failed and neutral results.
